tool_input.command: for f in package.json index.html pigment.app.json vite.config.ts src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx src/styles/base.css tests/smoke.spec.ts README.md .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done

foreach ($f in @('package.json','index.html','pigment.app.json','vite.config.ts','src/main.tsx','src/App.tsx','src/styles/base.css','tests/smoke.spec.ts','.gitignore')) { "=== $f"; Get-Content $f -Raw }; Get-ChildItem src/components,src/pages,src/data | ForEach-Object { "=== $($_.Name)"; Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw }
